page.overview:
What is S&M2?

S&M2 (short for "Symphony & Metallica 2") is a live album released by Metallica with the San Francisco Symphony, these concerts were made to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the original S&M. Although composer Michael Kamen didn't return to conduct the orchestra due to his passing 16 years prior, some of his compositions were used in these concerts. This time the orchestra were conducted by Edwin Outwater and Michael Tilson Thomas.
